title: Get /quit-smoking-app-for-iphone indexed (crawled, not indexed; 1 internal link)
body:
URL: /quit-smoking-app-for-iphone
Cluster: quit smoking app for iphone
Type: technical
Source: GSC 2026-09-29..2026-10-26, URL Inspection 2026-10-29

## Evidence
- URL Inspection 2026-10-29: "Crawled - currently not indexed". Last crawl 2026-07-04, before the 2026-10-13 edit.
- 0 impressions in GSC for 2026-09-29..2026-10-26 (and the window before).
- Only 1 internal link points to it (from /guides). The home page, /best-quit-smoking-apps and the comparison pages don't link to it.
- The home page title is "Blou – Quit Smoking App for iPhone: See Your Body Heal", so `/` and this page target the same query. Google already picked `/` for that intent (position 6.5, 96 impressions).
- The profile lists this page as a primary conversion page, so it matters more than its traffic suggests.

## Recommended action
1. Decide the page's job. Either (a) make it clearly different from `/`: a buyer's page for "best quit smoking app for iPhone" with iOS-specific details (iOS 17+, widgets/notifications only if in APP_FEATURES, pricing via PRICING_SHORT), or (b) 301 it to `/` and stop listing it as a conversion page. Prefer (a) unless the brief finds no distinct query.
2. If kept: add links in from `/`, /best-quit-smoking-apps, /quit-smoking-app-android and the six blou-vs-* pages.
3. After deploy, request indexing in GSC.

Don't change the home page title in this task.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
URL Inspection shows "Submitted and indexed" and the page gets impressions for "quit smoking app for iphone" queries within 4 weeks of the deploy, or it is redirected to `/` and removed from the profile's conversion list.

title: Get articles and tools indexed (20 non-guide pages not in Google's index)
body:
URL: /sitemap.xml
Cluster: article and tool indexing coverage
Type: technical
Source: URL Inspection 2026-10-29 (seo/data/gsc/inspection-pages-2026-10-29.json)

## Evidence
URL Inspection on 76 non-guide, non-state pages on 2026-10-29: 50 indexed, 12 crawled-not-indexed, 6 discovered-not-indexed, 8 unknown to Google. BLO-24 covers /guides only; this is the same problem for articles and tools.

Not covered by another issue:
- Unknown to Google: /alcohol-and-quitting-smoking (10 inbound links), /prepare-to-quit-smoking (30), /quitting-smoking-after-50 (6), /social-smoking (5), /tools/nicotine-pouch-calculator (6), /calculators/vietnam (3).
- Discovered, not indexed: /i-smoked-one-cigarette, /quitting-smoking-after-40, /smokers-lungs-vs-healthy-lungs, /tools/lung-recovery, /tools/nicotine-patch-plan.
- Crawled, not indexed: /health-benefits-of-quitting-smoking (crawled 2026-07-27), /how-long-does-nicotine-stay-in-your-system (2026-09-17), /quit-smoking-before-surgery (2026-09-19, thin), /quit-smoking-cold-turkey (2026-05-10, thin), /quit-smoking-with-anxiety (2026-09-11), /quit-smoking-with-depression (2026-07-27), /stop-smoking-today (2026-07-04, thin), /nrt-and-quit-smoking-app (2026-05-22, thin).

Tracked elsewhere: /quit-smoking-with-nicotine-patch (BLO-28), /quit-smoking-with-bupropion (BLO-29), /quit-vaping-timeline (BLO-17), /quit-smoking-app-for-iphone, /nicotine-withdrawal-timeline and /first-week-quit-smoking (new issues from this audit), /about (BLO-10).

Pages with 5-30 internal links that Google has never seen suggest a crawl-budget or sitemap-reading problem, not missing links.

## Recommended action
1. Check in GSC when sitemap.xml was last read and how many URLs it reports. Resubmit it.
2. Request indexing for the 6 unknown URLs first (most links, best topic fit: /prepare-to-quit-smoking, /alcohol-and-quitting-smoking, /tools/nicotine-pouch-calculator).
3. For the crawled-not-indexed pages under ~700 words, put them on the refresh list rather than re-requesting as they are.
4. Run this together with BLO-24 so the same playbook covers both.

## Next skill
None (manual GSC work), then seo-content-brief for the thin pages.

## Done when
At least 12 of the 20 pages show "Submitted and indexed" on re-inspection by 2026-11-26.

title: Refresh /nicotine-withdrawal-timeline (crawled, not indexed, 19 internal links)
body:
URL: /nicotine-withdrawal-timeline
Cluster: nicotine withdrawal timeline
Type: refresh
Source: GSC 2026-09-29..2026-10-26, URL Inspection 2026-10-29

## Evidence
- URL Inspection 2026-10-29: "Crawled - currently not indexed", last crawl 2026-07-19. 0 impressions in both 28-day windows.
- 19 pages link to it, including `/`, so this isn't a discovery problem. Google crawled it and chose not to index it.
- 745 words. The same days 1–30 ground is covered by /quit-smoking-timeline (new 2026-10-15, 212 impressions, position 66), the 11 /guides/what-happens-after-* pages, /zyn-withdrawal and /vape-withdrawal-symptoms. Google probably sees it as a near-duplicate.

## Recommended action
Decide with BLO-18 (the /quit-smoking-timeline refresh):
- Either make this the withdrawal-symptom timeline (cravings, mood, sleep, appetite by day, with the peak on days 2–3, sourced to NHS/Smokefree.gov), clearly different from the body-recovery timeline on /quit-smoking-timeline, and link each day to the matching guide;
- or 301 it to /quit-smoking-timeline and add a "withdrawal" section there.
Don't ship both as near-duplicates. Request indexing after the change.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
The page is indexed with impressions for "nicotine withdrawal timeline" by 2026-12-10, or it is redirected and /quit-smoking-timeline picks up those queries.

title: Refresh /first-week-quit-smoking (crawled, not indexed, 541 words)
body:
URL: /first-week-quit-smoking
Cluster: first week quit smoking
Type: refresh
Source: GSC 2026-09-29..2026-10-26, URL Inspection 2026-10-29

## Evidence
- URL Inspection 2026-10-29: "Crawled - currently not indexed", last crawl 2026-07-18. 0 impressions in both 28-day windows.
- 541 words (inventory flags it thin). 7 internal links in.
- Overlaps /guides/what-happens-after-1-week (1,069 words, 37 links in), which covers the body side of week 1.

## Recommended action
Keep the habit-plan angle ("day-by-day habits that hold") and make it clearly the practical plan: a day 1–7 table of what to do (triggers, sleep, caffeine, cravings), what to expect each day in one line linking to the matching guide, and an SOS section. Aim for 1,000+ useful words, sources listed. Link to /guides/what-happens-after-1-week for the body changes instead of repeating them. Request indexing after deploy.

If the brief finds no query this page can own apart from the guide, redirect it to /guides/what-happens-after-1-week instead.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
URL Inspection shows indexed and the page gets impressions for "first week quit smoking" by 2026-12-10.

title: Refresh /nicotine-withdrawal-symptoms into the symptom hub (indexed, 0 impressions)
body:
URL: /nicotine-withdrawal-symptoms
Cluster: nicotine withdrawal symptoms
Type: refresh
Source: GSC 2026-09-29..2026-10-26, URL Inspection 2026-10-29

## Evidence
- Indexed (last crawl 2026-09-19) but 0 impressions in both 28-day windows, for a head term that matches our largest traffic source (symptom guides).
- 435 words, the thinnest page on the site after the hubs. Only 2 internal links in (/guides, /how-to-quit-smoking).
- The symptom guides it should point to are where the impressions are: /guides/diarrhea 605, dreams-and-sleep 367, joint-pain 242, nausea 154, heart-palpitations 119, night-sweats 93, dizziness 84. 41 of 56 guides are still not indexed (BLO-24), so a strong hub linking all of them would help that issue too.

## Recommended action
Rewrite as the hub for nicotine withdrawal symptoms: answer-first box (common symptoms, when they peak, how long they last, sourced to NHS/Smokefree.gov/CDC), a table of every symptom guide with one line each and a link, "when to call a doctor", FAQ from GSC symptom queries, sources. Link to it from /guides, /quit-smoking-timeline, /nicotine-withdrawal-timeline and the top 6 symptom guides. Don't change titles on the symptom guides here (BLO-11 to BLO-14 own those).

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
The page has 100+ impressions per 28 days for "nicotine withdrawal symptoms" queries by 2026-12-24, and the linked guides it lists are recrawled.
